facts.text: The project is a Python GUI that operates New Era syringe pumps such as the NE-500/501
The upstream runs on Python 2 and requires PyQt4 and the serial module
The GUI opens the serial port at 19200 baud with a 0.1-second timeout
Pump discovery writes the CR-terminated query '<address>ADR' and accepts a non-empty reply
The broadcast stop is the CR-terminated command '*STP'
A rate is set by a per-pump '<address>DIR<INF|WDR>' line followed by one '<address>RAT<value><UH|MH>' line; several pump rates are chained with '*' and the line ends with CR
Rates below 5000 are sent in UH; at 5000 and above the rate is divided by 1000 and sent in MH
A rate is read by '<address>DIR' and '<address>RAT'; a WDR direction gives a negative sign and an MH reply is multiplied by 1000 to obtain UH
The syringe diameter is written by '<address>DIA<millimetres>' and read by '<address>DIA'
The GUI shows the current flow rate with the unit 'ul/hr'
The clone lists no maximum or minimum rate, diameter, volume or duration; set_rates only switches the unit at 5000 UH
